sql: select r.created_at, r.status, r.passed, r.failed, r.errors, r.cost_usd, (select string_agg(x.scenario_key || '=' || x.status || coalesce('[' || (select string_agg(c->>'id', ',') from jsonb_array_elements(x.checks) c where c->>'ok' = 'false') || ']', '') || coalesce(' ERR:' || left(x.error, 80), ''), ' | ' order by x.status) from public.ai_sim_results x where x.run_id = r.id) as detalhe from public.ai_sim_runs r where r.id = '293482d7-370e-4ded-97c7-0f7065599b32'
